props.name: anchor
props.description: The element it points at, or a virtual one (a selection's rect, see FloatingVirtualElement). Nothing renders while it's null.

props.name: sideOffset
props.description: Gap between the anchor and the layer, pointer included.

props.name: collisionPadding
props.description: How close to the viewport edge it may go.

props.name: children
props.type: (state: { side: FloatingSide arrowRef: React.RefObject<HTMLElement | null> arrowStyle: React.CSSProperties }) => React.ReactNode
props.description: Gets the side it ended up on and the pointer's props (ref and position).
